## Disposition and exact mathematical scope

Publish the accepted bounded partial results for 30001576 / OWR-4427-011, the odd two-torsion theta pure-codimension question. The global all-genus target remains **UNRESOLVED**, with the existing proof-route budget **5/5** and zero new proof-search turns. No all-genus solution, global counterexample, novelty, exhaustive-literature, formal-verification, or journal-acceptance claim is made.

The target is the reduced support of the interior locus of complex principally polarized abelian varieties, including decomposables, having an odd two-torsion theta singularity of multiplicity at least three. Each nonempty irreducible component is conjectured to have codimension g. Empty g=1,2 cases are vacuous. Gradient-scheme reducedness and compactified zero-locus equality are separate questions.

Accepted partial conclusions are the elementary codimension upper bound, expected codimension for every component actually contained in the decomposable locus, the cubic-contraction transversality criterion, and the specified three-odd-factor diagonal local slice theorem. The latter applies in each g>=3 where every gamma_j-3*beta_j^2 is nonzero, using a convergent heat expansion, holomorphic elimination, uniform local remainder bounds, and the local intersection inequality. Finite exact computations in g=3..8 do not establish the all-genus local proof.

The conditional rank-one induction retains both its lower-genus codimension hypothesis and actual access to the open rank-one boundary stratum. Its Cartier argument is made on a fine level cover, then descended by finite dimension preservation. Noncompleteness alone does not supply that access. No argument places an arbitrary global component through the required diagonal points. Jacobian rank at the specified diagonal points is exactly three; for g>3 the local dimension conclusion gives neither smoothness nor reducedness of the entire gradient scheme.

The 2023 finite-jet algebraic-independence criterion critique is expressly limited. Nilpotence in the literal jet quotient is a vacuity observation, while independent polynomial representatives need not generate an ideal of the predicted height. This does not refute the theta theorem or its theta-specific local dimension conclusion.

## Complete proof, audit, and clarification

The full current proof is current/PARTIAL_RESULTS.md. It is precisely the original proof plus the independently accepted contextual current/PROOF_INTERFACE_PATCH.diff, applied with zero fuzz and no offset. The patch clarifies the level-subgroup inclusion, boundary Cartier cover, Ciliberto–van der Geer relative-singular-locus interface, and Teixidor r=2 spin-moduli dimension import with the separate genus-five endpoint. The superseded full proof is omitted.

current/AUDIT.md and current/PROOF_INTERFACE_ADDENDUM.md are the complete byte-preserved audit and addendum. The addendum supplies the all-genus weighted-graph derivation, factorial-sensitive full third jet, local uniformity argument, and exact dimension interfaces. Historical statements about the frozen proof and no publication describe their original audit stage; they do not replace the current disposition. All local source inputs remain unchanged.

The accepted source-free audit archive had 15195 bytes and SHA-256 f58f204e674110c22394562b96b77b552720fac93d871bd38bfc7954de3155ab. The underlying source-free partial packet had 15342 bytes and SHA-256 faab5c1f34ad8e5f0892fb01c3797bfc427eb3e40d2f8d2f4684ab86e8596c05. Their public member bytes were checked locally; archives and excluded private inventories are not republished.

## Sources and search limits

The primary problem is [OWR 39/2010, Conjecture 1, printed p.2324](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46295). The relation to the stronger reducedness formulation is described in [Grushevsky–Hulek, arXiv:1103.1857v2, §2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1103.1857v2). The conditional boundary interface comes from [Grushevsky–Salvati Manni, arXiv:0805.4148v1, Proposition 12 and Theorem 13](https://arxiv.org/abs/0805.4148v1), with the relative singular-locus dimension from [Ciliberto–van der Geer, Theorem (2.4)](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/9911127v2). The spin import is [Teixidor i Bigas, Half-canonical series on algebraic curves, Theorem (2.17)](https://hdl.handle.net/2445/151640), using projective dimension r=2 and a separate g=5 argument.

The more recent diagonal result is [Grushevsky–Salvati Manni, arXiv:2307.05238v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.05238v2). Its exact theorem hypothesis, finite-jet lemma, and distinction from a global solution are retained in the full authored audit. Existing public-source titles, URLs, PDF sizes/hashes and inspection history are historical metadata, not fresh publication-stage retrieval, journal acceptance, or a worldwide openness/novelty guarantee. No source bodies or copied source documents are included.

## Fresh exact replay and delivery controls

Both original checkers are byte-preserved. The original has explicit guards and no file writes, and is optimization-safe, but its comparisons do not detect removal of repeated-edge factorials. The independent ordered-operator-word checker validates the entire third jet, including coefficients 1/6 and 1/2, and closes that coverage gap.

Each normal/-O/-OO suite requires two complete positive checker outputs and six separate intended mathematical rejection cases: factorial removal, wrong heat scale, wrong cross-term multiplicity, wrong elimination sign, wrong residual coefficient, and wrong elliptic Fourier coefficient. Each rejection must have its exact intended reason. Complete stdout/stderr/exit-code equality and recursive exact types, case identities, order and counts are enforced. Output is never normalized; PASS-only, skipped, empty, wrong-reason and wrong-type substitutes are rejected.

Each mode separately passes 48 integrity negatives, 60 schema/scope negatives, 30 exact-comparator negatives, and 35 real create/append-open/unlink permission denials at actual UID=EUID=1000. The installed-package adapter also passes the complete hostile cwd/Python-environment test, including fake SymPy and mpmath imports, without a sentinel write. Entire baseline raw output is identical under that hostile environment, and whole-delivery before/after snapshots match. Modes 0444/0555 test accidental-write resistance; they do not protect against root or deliberate owner chmod. These delivery controls are separate from the six mathematical mutations and add no mathematical coverage.

The actual target-only additive diff was applied in a fresh relocated directory. It reproduced every delivered byte and passed all three baseline modes with complete raw equality to the sealed original baseline.

## Explicit trust path and NOT_RUN stages

The tested dependencies are CPython 3.12.14 and its standard library, trusted installed SymPy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0. The packet does not cryptographically attest those installations. The explicit run_checker.py adapter requires -I -S -B, validates the installed package origins under the runtime prefix, and rejects other versions. It appends only that trusted installed-package directory, without site or .pth processing, never the packet, cwd or PYTHONPATH. It does not install packages or fall back to ordinary cwd imports. Direct unisolated invocation of preserved scripts is outside the supported path.

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py using its independently reviewed SHA-256 below, then keep that exact copy outside the packet. Make every delivered file 0444 and directory 0555, and run as actual UID=EUID=1000:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

The fixed external bootstrap binds the whole manifest, verifier and control harness before execution. The manifest binds all other delivered bytes, including complete raw references, contracts, code, reports and historical metadata. It excludes itself and the bootstrap to avoid a cycle; the reviewed PR body independently pins the bootstrap. Final external and relocated-diff receipts remain outside the delivered inventory and are pinned below. The external receipt binds the complete raw final-mode receipts by sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

Full historical audit harness, historical receipt replay, excluded original snapshot harness, pre-seal capture harness, superseded full proof replay, source-body replay, new source search, dataset replay, formal proof-assistant verification, global all-genus verification, arbitrary-period-matrix evaluation, and independent reproof of imported dimension theorems are explicitly **NOT_RUN** by the final public replay. The contextual patch was checked against the omitted original proof before sealing; applying it using only the delivered files is not claimed. Current checker replay is distinct from historical harness recreation.

Only unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001576 is added. No QUEUE, unrelated repository path, copied source PDF/text, dataset contents, private sources, private coordination material, or identifying metadata for excluded private files is included.
